import numpy as np, sys
from net import *
rng = np.random.default_rng(0)
r = sample(2_000_000, rng)
s = score(r); p = protocol(r); m = margin(r)
net = s>0
bad = (net!=p) & (m>0.3)
print("disagree frac", bad.mean(), bad.sum())
cov,cap,ml,mip,pv,cl,cf,miss = r.T
forced = mip-0.05*pv
A=cov>cap; B=(forced>0.1)&(cov>ml); C=cl<cf; D=miss==1
for name,mask in [("A",A),("B",B),("C",C),("D",D),("none",~(A|B|C|D))]:
    mm = bad & mask
    print(name, "n", mask.sum(), "bad", mm.sum(), "net esc among bad", (net[mm]).mean() if mm.sum() else None)
# false negatives: protocol escalate but net plans
fn = bad & p
print("FN", fn.sum(), " of which only-B:", (fn & B & ~A & ~C & ~D).sum(), "only-A", (fn&A&~B&~C&~D).sum(), "only-C", (fn&C&~A&~B&~D).sum(), "only-D",(fn&D&~A&~B&~C).sum())
fp = bad & ~p
print("FP", fp.sum())
if fp.sum():
    idx = np.where(fp)[0][:10]
    np.set_printoptions(precision=2, suppress=True, linewidth=200)
    print(r[idx]); print(s[idx])
if fn.sum():
    idx = np.where(fn)[0][:10]
    np.set_printoptions(precision=2, suppress=True, linewidth=200)
    print(r[idx]); print(s[idx])
